observation.command:
echo '--- guide login command verbatim ---'
echo 'Harbor12345' | docker login localhost:80 -u admin --password-stdin
echo '--- retry tag delete with fresh token ---'
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost/c/token -d 'grant_type=password&username=admin&password=Harbor12345' | tr -d '"' | sed 's/^[^=]*=//')
DIGEST='sha256:7cefa58bd70cbf86bb0ef44b9c27a9c6a633763977ea40868d1bfe9278967b25'
curl -s -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' "http://localhost/api/v2.0/projects/library/repositories/alpine/artifacts/${DIGEST}/tags/validation-test"
sleep 2; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost/v2/library/alpine/tags/list
